fuentes_de_origen.fuente: NASA ECOSTRESS ECO_L3T_JET.002 («ECOSTRESS Tiled Evapotranspiration Instantaneous and Daytime L3 Global 70 m V002», Hook and Halverson 2024, DOI 10.5067/ECOSTRESS/ECO_L3T_JET.002, NASA LP DAAC); daily ET (ETdaily: median of four models of the instantaneous latent heat flux, scaled to the daylight hours, sunrise to sunset) at 70 m, collection 2, via AppEEARS v3.137 (AppEEARS Team 2026, «Application for Extracting and Exploring Analysis Ready Samples (AppEEARS). Ver. 3.137», NASA EOSDIS LP DAAC, USGS/EROS; point samples: requests raiz_ecostress_delicias_saucillo, ID 8d53d4fe-9e3f-48ee-8947-84078f3f8c99, and raiz_ecostress_lazaro_cardenas, ID 520f1233-5eb1-4c4e-b243-2c43940f784b, Nov 14, 2026; the README.md of each request, with both citations, unchanged in data/raw/reto/ecostress_readme_<zona>.md), one point inside each field, Oct 1, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026; a pass is used when ETdaily has data with cloud = 0 and water = 0, when no more than 25 % of the area's points are cloudy in that scene and when the pass falls between 0.15 and 0.85 of the daylight hours (assumptions [S] in supuestos.json); scenes less than 5 minutes apart are one overpass and are averaged; et_mm_dia = median of the overpasses of the month, n_escenas = number of overpasses; units: mm/day (user guide text and JPL code; its Table 10 says W/m²); overpasses with data in Oct, Dec, Jan (Delicias–Saucillo) and Aug, none used in May and Jul; extra columns zona, etc_modelo_mm (median, on the same days, of the A5 Kc times the NASA POWER ETo; classified fields within the crop cycle and, for annual crops, months in which HLS sees the field green), razon (et_mm_dia / etc_modelo_mm; different quantities, not a validation), et_min_mm_dia and et_max_mm_dia (lowest and highest overpass of the month) and incertidumbre_w_m2 (median ETinstUncertainty, W/m²: standard deviation among the four models at the pass; 29 to 231 over all clear passes, 10th to 90th percentiles); satellite estimate at 70 m on clear days, not a field measurement; raw AppEEARS output unchanged in data/raw/reto/ecostress_pasos_<zona>.csv; independent review of Nov 15, 2026 (docs/revisiones/2026-11-15_ecostress.md)

suelo.json:margen_ph.valor.fuente: Own criterion (Nov 14, 2026): a pH difference smaller than this margin between the map and the published limit of a crop is not labeled «outside range» but «near the published limit». It does not come from a pH uncertainty figure: Table 4 of Poggio et al. 2021 (DOI 10.5194/soil-7-217-2021) is an image and could not be read; the text of the article gives model efficiencies (MEC) of 0.31 to 0.74 depending on the property, and ISRIC states that its models explain between 30 % and 70 % of the variation
suelo.json:margen_ph.valor.script: datos/supuestos.json (read by the scripts of datos/colab/); motor/suelo_web.py

suelo.json:coincidencia_textura.valor.fuente: Share of fields where the USDA texture class computed from SoilGrids 2.0 (0–30 cm) equals the OpenLandMap one (0 cm): 584 of 1,238 fields with data in the two pilot areas; in the others they differ by a neighboring class

contexto.json:ecostress.fecha.fuente: NASA ECOSTRESS ECO_L3T_JET.002 («ECOSTRESS Tiled Evapotranspiration Instantaneous and Daytime L3 Global 70 m V002», Hook and Halverson 2024, DOI 10.5067/ECOSTRESS/ECO_L3T_JET.002, NASA LP DAAC); daily ET (ETdaily: median of four models of the instantaneous latent heat flux, scaled to the daylight hours, sunrise to sunset) at 70 m, collection 2, via AppEEARS v3.137 (AppEEARS Team 2026, «Application for Extracting and Exploring Analysis Ready Samples (AppEEARS). Ver. 3.137», NASA EOSDIS LP DAAC, USGS/EROS; point samples: requests raiz_ecostress_delicias_saucillo, ID 8d53d4fe-9e3f-48ee-8947-84078f3f8c99, and raiz_ecostress_lazaro_cardenas, ID 520f1233-5eb1-4c4e-b243-2c43940f784b, Nov 14, 2026; the README.md of each request, with both citations, unchanged in data/raw/reto/ecostress_readme_<zona>.md), one point inside each field, Oct 1, 2025 to Sep 30, 2026; a pass is used when ETdaily has data with cloud = 0 and water = 0, when no more than 25 % of the area's points are cloudy in that scene and when the pass falls between 0.15 and 0.85 of the daylight hours (assumptions [S] in supuestos.json); scenes less than 5 minutes apart are one overpass and are averaged; et_mm_dia = median of the overpasses of the month, n_escenas = number of overpasses; units: mm/day (user guide text and JPL code; its Table 10 says W/m²); overpasses with data in Oct, Dec, Jan (Delicias–Saucillo) and Aug, none used in May and Jul; extra columns zona, etc_modelo_mm (median, on the same days, of the A5 Kc times the NASA POWER ETo; classified fields within the crop cycle and, for annual crops, months in which HLS sees the field green), razon (et_mm_dia / etc_modelo_mm; different quantities, not a validation), et_min_mm_dia and et_max_mm_dia (lowest and highest overpass of the month) and incertidumbre_w_m2 (median ETinstUncertainty, W/m²: standard deviation among the four models at the pass; 29 to 231 over all clear passes, 10th to 90th percentiles); satellite estimate at 70 m on clear days, not a field measurement; raw AppEEARS output unchanged in data/raw/reto/ecostress_pasos_<zona>.csv; independent review of Nov 15, 2026 (docs/revisiones/2026-11-15_ecostress.md)
